dialogues.speaker: Ritou Harbor Bulletin Board
dialogues.text: This Ritou Harbor bulletin board was set up by the Shogunate. Notices regarding all kinds of matters will be posted here. Do not post without authorization.

dialogues.speaker: Kanjou Notice
dialogues.text: Former Kanjou Commissioner Hiiragi Shinsuke now awaits the Almighty Shogun's judgment regarding his crimes of high treason. Owing to his age and in acknowledgment of his past contributions, he is presently indefinitely detained without bail.

dialogues.speaker: Kanjou Notice
dialogues.text: However, should he commit any more acts of treason during this detention, he will be branded a public enemy of the Inazuman state and his judgment shall be enacted with extreme prejudice and without any mercy.

dialogues.speaker: Kanjou Notice
dialogues.text: While the Kanjou Commission debates the matter of his successor, the Commission's duties shall be performed by a personal deputy of Her Excellency.

dialogues.speaker: Kanjou Notice
dialogues.text: The duties of Kanjou Commission staff will not be adjusted. We urge all staff to remain calm and follow any arrangements sent from your superiors.

dialogues.speaker: Port Affairs Announcement
dialogues.text: As we are presently in a state of ceasefire and peace, imports to Watatsumi Island will resume.

dialogues.speaker: Port Affairs Announcement
dialogues.text: Once the matter of trade route security is agreed upon by both the Shogunate and Sangonomiya, the commercial port to Watatsumi Island will be opened shortly.

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "The war is finally over. But rather than feeling joy, I think I feel something more akin to liberation, like a heavy burden was lifted off my back."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "The supervisors that the Yashiro Commissioner sent have done their duties admirably, decreasing the merchants' burden by a fair amount..."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "And while the Sakoku Decree has not yet been repealed, it seems that business has turned around... There's hope for the future now, and no mistake."

dialogues.speaker: Port Affairs Announcement
dialogues.text: Yashiori Island's Jakotsu Mine has been closed temporarily, with representatives from the Shogunate and Sangonomiya discussing future development. It will be reopened soon after an agreement has been reached.

dialogues.speaker: Port Affairs Announcement
dialogues.text: Former miners from Jakotsu may claim job loss compensation from the Yashiro Commission estates and may also take the occasion to indicate preferred avenues of future employment.

dialogues.speaker: Kanjou Notice
dialogues.text: The special privileges granted to Snezhnayan merchants in trade and in port affairs have been revoked. Any accumulated arrears must be paid within 2 weeks, or Ritou will not extend further protection to your goods and cargo.

dialogues.speaker: Kanjou Notice
dialogues.text: We ask all shipments of military equipment and material to leave the borders of Inazuma and Sangonomiya immediately. The Fatui and all related personnel are included in this order.

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "I am but a humble leather goods contractor for the Shogun's Army and have nothing to do with the Fatui. I only knew of the war through the financial statements I went through..."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "I have also only just gotten my permanent business permit from the Kanjou Commission. Am I still to be chased out nonetheless...?"

dialogues.speaker: Reply
dialogues.text: We apologize for the inconvenience we have caused you, but please do leave within the allotted time.

dialogues.speaker: Missing Person Poster
dialogues.text: I'm searching for my husband, Inaba Tousaburou Kyuuzou. He is a tall man without any facial hair and has a scar on the side of his forehead. He has yet to return home despite the ceasefire.

dialogues.speaker: Missing Person Poster
dialogues.text: If any returning samurai or old friends and acquaintances know of his whereabouts, please inform me. You will be duly thanked for your help!

dialogues.speaker: Missing Person Poster
dialogues.text: Yours Respectfully, Inaba Shizuko.

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "I was often stuck doing lots of rear echelon work, so I never got to see the grand sights of Inazuma City. But today, I finally got my wish."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "The locals here in Ritou were pretty restrained. I guess it's because not too long ago, we were still at each others' throats..."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "But we were welcomed very warmly by the outlanders. Couldn't find one of their stores without discounts for us Watatsumi folk anywhere you looked."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Looks like our actions did have a positive impact on their lives after all... I'm glad that all the unfortunate things that happened so far were not meaningless after all."

dialogues.speaker: Arataki "A Vision Returned" Itto
dialogues.text: "Ahahaha! Ever since I got my Vision back, I've been super motivated! Guess who's back? That's right! I'm back!"

dialogues.speaker: Arataki "A Vision Returned" Itto
dialogues.text: "C'mon, Kujou Tengu! So I heard that you got a hiding and had to flee all the way back here. I'm practically laughing myself silly over here, you know? Ahahaha!"

dialogues.speaker: Arataki "A Vision Returned" Itto
dialogues.text: "I'll be waiting for you at the port just for an extra laugh! And don't forget about our duel!"

dialogues.speaker: Reply
dialogues.text: Would you shut up already? I heard you the first time!

dialogues.speaker: Kanjou Notice
dialogues.text: This message has been left specifically by Madam Sara and may not be removed.

dialogues.speaker: Reply
dialogues.text: I did not leave that there! Have it removed at once! Do your jobs, you people of the Outlander Affairs Agency, will you!?

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Watching these 'traitors' who so often had to give back before us saunter and shop their way through Ritou..."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "And thinking back on all the losses and pain that we suffered during this war... bitterness wells up within me unbidden."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Still, I suppose that surviving and being able to reunite with my family was a good thing in the end... This war has just taken so much out of us all."

dialogues.speaker: Another Person's Message
dialogues.text: "I'm not sure if I get to say this, considering that we were enemies..."

dialogues.speaker: Another Person's Message
dialogues.text: "But we've been given a new opportunity by this peace, haven't we? I hear that Uyuu Restaurant is pretty famous around these parts. Let's go get a drink there some time."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "...Don't you act so familiar with me."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "I came here to Ritou specifically to look for a Tenryou samurai who once gave me a sword wound on the battlefield."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "I was going to thank him for not striking a fatal blow then and ask him for another duel."

dialogues.speaker: Another Person's Message
dialogues.text: "I hate to break it to you, but now that we are at peace, Her Excellency the Shogun has banned all duels with real swords save for duels before the throne."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Agh, come on! That's so boring! ... Ah, whatever. Let's just go get a drink or something, eh?"

dialogues.speaker: Another Person's Message
dialogues.text: "Speaking of drinking, I do know a good spot. Meet me at the docks later?"

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Alright, that'd be great!"

dialogues.speaker: Grand Narukami Shrine Notice
dialogues.text: With Lady Miko's permission, the Grand Shrine will soon host a large-scale event.

dialogues.speaker: Grand Narukami Shrine Notice
dialogues.text: This is a rare opportunity, so we encourage all shrine maidens, clergy, and commission staff to make preparations soon!

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "While the war has finally ended, pirates still infest our waters, so be on your guard when you travel afar, friends."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "I have heard that the authorities are presently in negotiations and that they might resume a cooperative security arrangement with Sangonomiya."

dialogues.speaker: Another Person's Message
dialogues.text: "That would certainly be for the best."

dialogues.speaker: Shogunate Announcement
dialogues.text: Their Excellencies, the Almighty Ogosho and Watatsumi's Divine Priestess, both express their deep grief at the many tragedies that occurred at Tatarasuna and on Yashiori Island.

dialogues.speaker: Shogunate Announcement
dialogues.text: From this day forth, the Shogunate and Sangonomiya will begin reconstruction and redevelopment work in these lands in partnership with one another.

dialogues.speaker: Shogunate Announcement
dialogues.text: Together, we will pacify this war-torn land, bring the guilty to justice, and restore Inazuma's prosperity.

dialogues.speaker: Shogunate Announcement
dialogues.text: All the more must we follow the divine wisdom of Her Excellency the Shogun, acting as one to accomplish the great cause of Eternity.

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "The Kanjou Commission has restored a few trade routes on a limited basis, even though this only brings in a meager income even for larger shops..."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "On the other hand, the hard work of the supervisors from the Yashiro Commission has seen many exorbitant taxes canceled."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "For our outlanders, our purse-strings will probably remain tight for a while yet, but at least we've got some room to breathe..."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Regardless, these changes are certainly for the better."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "A friend who used to go out fishing together with me has returned. His time in the war seems to have left him very melancholy indeed."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Our neighbors have some reservations about him due to his having joined the resistance army, and have kept their distance for the most part..."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "But it doesn't matter much to me. He's my friend and that's what counts!"

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "The very next day after the ceasefire came into effect, a ship from Sangonomiya arrived, claiming to want to purchase some lifestyle goods from Yae Publishing House."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "I mean, that's what I heard, at least."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "That said, I've got no clue what lifestyle goods they thought they'd get at a bookstore..."
